source: Exact camp drill list supplied by Coach Rich

Battling.name: 1 vs 1 Angling Drill
Battling.description: Once completed, players go up the wall. Player starts with the puck on the wall. Opposite player tries to take it and score.

Battling.name: 1 vs 1 Puck Race Passing It Off of the Back of the Net
Battling.description: 1 vs 1 Puck race passing it off of the back of the net.

Games.name: Tennis Ball Shootout Challenge
Games.description: Player shoots then plays goalie for the following player.

Games.name: War
Games.description: Players have a line they cannot cross and they try to shoot it over to the opposite side. Whoever clears the most pucks wins!

Passing.name: Partner Line Passing
Passing.description: Player skates and makes a pass then follows their pass.

Shooting.name: Agility - Knee Touches - Then Sprint Thru the Sticks
Shooting.description: Agility - knee touches - then sprint thru the sticks.

Shooting.name: React to Coach's Arm
Shooting.description: If the coach lifts an arm, go to the opposite side and shoot.

Shooting.name: Wrist Shot
Shooting.description: 2 lines. Coach on each side of the net. Player receives pass and shoots.

Skating.name: 2 Line Powerskating Cone to Cone
Skating.description: Once players get to the cone they stay there.

Stickhandling.name: Pull Under 2 Bars
Stickhandling.description: 2 lines going at once on opposite sides of the nets. Hook in like they are racing - both players shoot. Bars are are wide enough that they don't impact the net player regarding lane size. Pull the puck from inside to outside. Hook around the cone and shoot.
